name: codex-accounts-manager
description: Manage multiple Codex accounts in VS Code, inspect quota, and switch the active global auth.json.

codexAccounts.codexAppRestartMode.markdownDescription: How to handle the Codex desktop experience restart when switching accounts. Supports both the merged ChatGPT app and legacy Codex app. `auto` restarts it automatically, `manual` asks you to click restart each time.

codexAccounts.codexAppRestartEnabled.markdownDescription: Whether Codex Accounts Manager should manage the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app when switching accounts. Turn this off to skip restart prompts and app handling entirely.

codexAccounts.dashboardTheme.markdownDescription: Theme used by the Codex Accounts dashboard. `auto` follows the current VS Code color theme.

codexAccounts.displayLanguage.markdownDescription: Language used by Codex Accounts Manager. `auto` follows the current VS Code display language. Dashboard, details, and core notifications use localized copy when available and fall back to English for any missing edge-case strings.

codexAccounts.autoRefreshMinutes.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh all saved account quotas every N minutes. Set to `0` to disable, or choose any interval from `1` to `60` minutes.

codexAccounts.autoRefreshCurrentMinutes.markdownDescription: Automatically refresh only the current active account quota every N minutes. Set to `0` to disable, or choose any interval from `1` to `60` minutes.

codexAccounts.usageHistoryRetentionDays.markdownDescription: How long quota graph history is retained. Choose a retention period from `1` to `90` days.

codexAccounts.autoResumeCodexSessions.markdownDescription: Reopen the official VS Code Codex conversation tabs that were open in this workspace after VS Code starts or reloads. Stores only the tab URIs and labels; it does not inspect accounts or conversation content.

codexAccounts.cliIntegrationEnabled.markdownDescription: Allow the dashboard to read local Codex CLI session indexes and transcripts on demand, and gate automatic VS Code Codex session resume. No session files are read while this is disabled.

codexAccounts.backgroundTokenRefreshEnab.markdownDescription: Allow the extension to refresh saved account tokens in the background. Disabled by default; Codex manages its own token refresh unless you enable this.

codexAccounts.autoSwitchEnabled.markdownDescription: Automatically switch away from the active account when its quota falls below the configured hourly or weekly threshold. Candidates are ranked by highest remaining 5-hour quota, then highest weekly quota.

codexAccounts.hourlyQuotaControlEnabled.markdownDescription: Show the 5-hour quota in the status bar and allow it to trigger automatic account switching and quota warning notifications. The quota remains visible in the dashboard.

codexAccounts.autoSwitchReloadWindowEnab.markdownDescription: Automatically reload the current VS Code window after an automatic account switch when the active runtime account changes.

codexAccounts.autoSwitchHourlyThreshold.markdownDescription: Automatic account switching threshold for the 5-hour quota. Switching is triggered when the active account drops to or below this percentage.

codexAccounts.autoSwitchWeeklyThreshold.markdownDescription: Automatic account switching threshold for the weekly quota. Switching is triggered when the active account drops to or below this percentage.

codexAccounts.autoSwitchLockMinutes.markdownDescription: Default lock duration in minutes when temporarily locking the current account against automatic account switching. Set to `0` to disable locking by default.

codexAccounts.codexAppPath.markdownDescription: Optional custom path to the Codex desktop app. If empty, the extension uses built-in platform-specific detection.

codexAccounts.quotaWarningEnabled.markdownDescription: Show a warning notification when the active account's 5-hour or weekly remaining quota drops below the configured threshold.

codexAccounts.quotaWarningThreshold.markdownDescription: Warning threshold percentage shared by the active account's 5-hour and weekly remaining quota.

codexAccounts.quotaGreenThreshold.markdownDescription: Quota percentage at or above this value is shown in green.

codexAccounts.quotaYellowThreshold.markdownDescription: Quota percentage at or above this value is shown in yellow. Values below this threshold are shown in red.

codexAccounts.debugNetwork.markdownDescription: Enable sanitized network debug logs for Codex Accounts Manager requests in the `Codex Accounts Network` output channel.

codexAccounts.encryptedSyncEnabled.markdownDescription: Synchronize saved account sessions and the per-account PC enablement registry through VS Code Settings Sync using a client-side encrypted vault. A signed-in VS Code Settings Sync machine can use Sync after entering the same passphrase. Sync is run after account toggles to share the latest registry; account usage, switching, and schedules never create sync traffic.

codexAccounts.webDashboardEnabled.markdownDescription: Run the local browser dashboard on 127.0.0.1:39875. Protect it with a password using the Set Web Dashboard Password command.
